author: SektorSector
quote: This game was a monumental let down. 13 years… 13 years! What a disappointment. First it was Spider-Man, then Call of Duty, then Halo, then Wolverine, the Gears of War, and now GTA 6. These feminists, and soy boy matcha drinking game developers ruin EVERYTHING they touch. After 4 hours of playing I couldn’t stomach it. I submitted a refund request and got my money back. Story line could’ve been fine if they gave Jason some balls and personality. Instead he wants to be good little boy and do chores and run errands for a very undeserving woman. The feminist themes couldn’t be more in our face. And for that, I give you a big FU. 0/100.
